title: The projection of a null-measurable L-Lipschitz graph piece is H^n-null-measurable
statement: Let N, n ∈ ℕ, P ∈ G(N,n) with orthogonal projection p := Grassmannian.project P, L ≥ 0, and let A ⊆ ℝ^N be an L-Lipschitz graph over P (|(y − z) − p(y − z)| ≤ L|p(y − z)| for all y, z ∈ A) that is H^n-null-measurable, H^n = μHE[n]. Then p(A) is H^n-null-measurable.
lean_statement: ∀ (N n : ℕ) (P : Grassmannian N n) (L : ℝ) (A : Set (Euclidean N)), 0 ≤ L → (∀ y ∈ A, ∀ z ∈ A, ‖(y - z) - Grassmannian.project P (y - z)‖ ≤ L * ‖Grassmannian.project P (y - z)‖) → NullMeasurableSet A (μHE[n] : Measure (Euclidean N)) → NullMeasurableSet (Grassmannian.project P '' A) (μHE[n] : Measure (Euclidean N))
